item.title: 10% of Cancer Research May be Fake – Paper Mills Exposed
item.description: An AI analysis finds nearly 10% of cancer studies show paper mill patterns, raising serious concerns about research quality. The post 10% of Cancer Research May be Fake – Paper Mills Exposed appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Ultrasound-Detected Synovitis Linked to Functional Impairment in Hand Osteoarthritis
item.description: Data from the LIHOA cohort show that ultrasound-detected synovitis and synovial thickening in hand osteoarthritis are associated with worse hand function but not pain intensity. The post Ultrasound-Detected Synovitis Linked to Functional Impairment in Hand Osteoarthritis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Topical JAK Inhibitor Shows Promise for Atopic Dermatitis
item.description: A phase IIb trial demonstrates that topical pumecitinib 3% gel significantly improves mild-to-moderate atopic dermatitis, with twice-daily dosing showing superior efficacy. The post Topical JAK Inhibitor Shows Promise for Atopic Dermatitis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: NSCLC Progression Type Predicts Survival
item.description: In advanced NSCLC, progression by new lesions predicted shorter post-progression survival following first-line therapy. The post NSCLC Progression Type Predicts Survival appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Tool Guides Care for Cancer Heart Attacks
item.description: The newly developed AI tool, known as ONCO-ACS, was designed specifically to predict six-month mortality, major bleeding, and ischaemic events in patients with cancer and acute coronary syndrome. The post AI Tool Guides Care for Cancer Heart Attacks appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.description: Matched lesion stroke analysis found hemorrhagic stroke caused worse disability and higher DALYs than ischemic stroke by year five. The post Hemorrhagic vs Ischemic Stroke Outcomes Diverge appeared first on European Medical Journal.
